name: Customer DXF Analysis
description: DXF analysis toolkit: interactive quoting viewer (layer-colored flat pattern, per-line measurements, layer reassignment incl. WELD, total linear inches, DXF export) plus hole/profile offsetting - grow every hole's diameter and shrink the outer profile per side (defaults 1/16"), for the loaded file via Adjust Dimensions or for a whole folder at once.
author: Anthony Sieben

fields.label: Default DXF File
fields.description: Optional DXF to open automatically in the viewer. Leave blank to pick a file each time.

fields.label: Hole diameter increase (inches)
fields.description: How much bigger each hole's DIAMETER gets when offsetting. Default 0.0625 (1/16").

fields.label: Plate edge offset per side (inches)
fields.description: How far each edge of the outer profile moves inward when offsetting. Default 0.0625 (1/16") - a 12x12 plate becomes 11.875x11.875.

fields.label: Layer name for holes
fields.description: Hole geometry is moved to this layer in the OFFSET output DXF.
